result.topic_en: Notes on the Newton–Leibniz priority dispute (quotations from the Commercium epistolicum and Raphson's History of Fluxions, Newton's statement about inventing series and fluxions in 1665–66, Newton's letter to Oldenburg of 24 Oct 1676 with a series for pi), followed by a German fragment on integrals with infinite discontinuities and upside-down pencil calculations.

And am not I as good a witness that I in-
vented the methods of Series and Fluxions

mathematical papers written in the years
1664, 1665, and 1666, some of which happen
